steps.title: Three steps to

conta.title: Create your account
conta.body: All you need is your name, an email and a password.

email.title: Confirm your email
email.body: Open the link we'll email you. Without it, the account doesn't count.

usar.title: Use the platform
usar.body: For example, add a company to your watchlist. That's how we know there's a real person on the other side.

steps.after: If you're among the first {total} people to complete the three steps, we'll email you to ask for a shipping address.

offerSubtitle: The whole platform, nothing locked. Only the AI Analyst has a daily limit.

fundamentais.title: 10 years of fundamentals
fundamentais.body: Revenue, margins, free cash flow, debt and shares outstanding for all 500 S&P 500 companies, from their filings with the SEC.
fundamentais.alt: Microsoft's Fundamentals tab with 10 years of revenue, segments and geography

avaliacao.title: Valuation
avaliacao.body: Today's multiples next to each company's history, so you can read the price in context.
avaliacao.alt: Microsoft's historical valuation: P/E over time with its average and median

dcf.title: Pre-filled DCF
dcf.body: The company's numbers are already in the calculator. Change the assumptions and watch each scenario's per-share value move.
dcf.alt: Microsoft DCF calculator with the Bear, Base and Bull scenarios

ia.title: AI Analyst in Portuguese
ia.body: Summary, competitive advantages, catalysts and risks for each company, explained in Portuguese.
ia.alt: AI Analyst with Microsoft's business summary and the label Source: 10-K

items.primeiros: The books go to the first {total} people who complete the three steps, first come, first served.
items.email: Only accounts with a confirmed email count.
items.usar: You need to use the platform at least once, for example by adding a company to your watchlist.
items.morada: We only ask winners for an address, by email. Never at sign-up.
items.fim: One book per person. The offer ends when the copies run out.

faq.title: Questions about
faq.a1: The economist Nuno Palma, author of «As Causas do Atraso Português», donated {total} copies for this campaign.
faq.q2: How do I know if I won a book?
faq.a2: If you're among the first {total} people to complete the three steps, we'll email you to ask for a shipping address. We only ask winners for an address.
faq.q3: What counts as using the platform?
faq.a3: A simple action inside the platform, such as adding a company to your watchlist.
faq.q4: How long will the books last?
faq.a4: Until the copies run out. The counter at the top of this page shows how many are left.
faq.a5: [To be decided by the team before publishing: how long the launch lasts, what happens afterwards and whether any payment details are asked for.]
faq.q6: Does BullValue tell me what to buy?
faq.a6: No. We show data, multiples and calculations so you can study companies and decide for yourself. Nothing here is investment advice.
